pendulum.base_prompt: A fixed-camera real-world laboratory video of a simple pendulum released from rest at the first frame. The support and camera remain stationary, and the bob swings naturally under gravity.

parameter_clauses.name: bob_radius
parameter_clauses.template: the spherical bob radius is {value} meters

parameter_clauses.name: pendulum_length
parameter_clauses.template: the pivot-to-bob-center pendulum length is {value} meters

parameter_clauses.name: initial_angle
parameter_clauses.template: the initial release angle is {value} degrees

free_fall.base_prompt: A fixed-camera real-world laboratory video of a spherical ball released from rest in free fall. The camera remains stationary, and the ball accelerates vertically downward under gravity at the true physical time scale.

parameter_clauses.name: initial_height
parameter_clauses.template: the initial vertical drop height is {value} meters

parameter_clauses.name: initial_velocity
parameter_clauses.template: the initial vertical velocity is {value} meters per second

collision_1d.base_prompt: A fixed-camera real-world laboratory video of a one-dimensional central collision among three aligned balls. At frame 0, all three balls are visible, with ball 1 on the left. Ball 1 moves toward initially stationary balls 2 and 3. The camera and track remain stationary, and the collision unfolds at the true physical time scale.

parameter_clauses.name: striker_initial_velocity
parameter_clauses.template: the striker initial velocity is {value} meters per second

decelerated_slide.base_prompt: A fixed-camera real-world laboratory video of a block sliding along a horizontal surface and slowing down due to kinetic friction. The camera and surface remain stationary, and the motion unfolds at the true physical time scale.

parameter_clauses.name: initial_velocity
parameter_clauses.template: the block initial velocity is {value} meters per second

uniform_circular_motion.base_prompt: A fixed-camera real-world laboratory video of an object undergoing uniform circular motion around a fixed center. The apparatus and camera remain stationary, and the rotation unfolds at the true physical time scale.

parameter_clauses.name: angular_velocity
parameter_clauses.template: the angular velocity is {value} radians per second
